records.name: İzmir
records.summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): İzmir — the most secular city in the country, visible community despite the national crackdown; the 13th Pride Week and its events were banned, and in May–June 2025 police broke up Pride-related public events with batons, tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets. Mülteci-Der's report on Syrian trans women living here found they cannot find work, face exploitation and harassment when they do, and have 'no faith in justice'. National frame: the leaked October 2025 draft would criminalise 'conduct contrary to biological sex' and its promotion (up to 3 years) and restrict gender-affirming care (minimum age 25); a 2025 rights report records hostility as explicit state policy, six violations of the right to life, trans people most affected. Scored relative to the national score (0.15) for Turkey.
